title: OpenAI shut down Sora on April 26, 2026 — $15M/day compute cost, $2.1M lifetime revenue

The lesson: specific AI tools are volatile; the content format they serve is not.

title: The trifecta is complete: Netflix (Apr 30), Amazon Prime Video (May 8) and Disney+ all launch vertical video feeds — vertical is now standard premium-streaming infrastructure
aiSummary: In the week of May 4–10 2026, all three major US subscription streamers launched vertical video feeds: Netflix rolled out 'Clips' on April 30 in 9 markets (US, UK, Australia, Canada, India and more); Amazon Prime Video launched its vertical 'Clips' feed on May 8; Disney+ had been running vertical programming via 'Locker Diaries' since February.
